claims.text: The installed client on this worktree is Cursor Agent 2026.08.11-e8db854 at /root/.local/share/cursor-agent/versions/2026.08.11-e8db854/cursor-agent. `claude` is not on PATH (claude_on_path=None). claims.strongest_caveat: Version string is this build only (2026.08.11-e8db854). A later agent upgrade can change the flag set.

claims.text: Non-interactive invocation is `-p`/`--print` plus `--output-format {text,json,stream-json}`. `--print` with no prompt exits 1 with 'No prompt provided for print mode' (reason=print-mode-no-prompt). Valid `--output-format stream-json` is accepted as a known value (print-mode-no-prompt); an invented format hits the enum (invalid-value: ['Invalid --output-format. Allowed values: text, json, stream-json']).
claims.canonical_mechanism: execute each documented flag once; classify unknown-option vs known-flag errors
claims.strongest_caveat: Parser acceptance is not a live stream-json session. Event shapes (system/init, assistant, tool_call, result) were not captured from a real run; they remain documentation-only.

claims.text: The Claude Code stream-json `control_request` / `control_response` stdin channel is REFUTED on this binary: JS byte search total=0 for 'control_request', 0 for 'control_response', 0 for 'permission-prompt-tool'. `--input-format` and `--permission-prompt-tool` are rejected as unknown options. This is not a capability of the installed client.
claims.canonical_mechanism: byte-search of shipped *.js independently of argv classification of Claude-doc flags
claims.strongest_caveat: A minified identifier rename could hide the string; the unknown-option results on the Claude flags are the independent second signal and would still stand.

claims.text: Permission / trust surface honoured by this binary is `--force`/`--yolo`, `--auto-review`, `--sandbox {enabled,disabled}`, and `--trust`. Claude `--permission-mode` is rejected (unknown-option). `--mode` accepts only plan|ask; value `agent` is invalid (invalid-value). `--sandbox` invented value is rejected by the choice enum while `disabled` is accepted.
claims.strongest_caveat: These checks prove parser acceptance, not that --force actually bypasses a tool prompt in a live session.

claims.text: This program's distributed runner (command-center/p2-wave/seed-stage/dispatch_cursor.py) currently passes ['--effort', '--force', '--model', '--output-format', '--sandbox', '--trust', '--workspace']. Accepted by the binary: ['--force', '--model', '--output-format', '--sandbox', '--trust', '--workspace']. Rejected by the binary: ['--effort']. `--effort` is rejected (unknown-option); agent_cmd() in dispatch_cursor.py lists it, launch_one() does not. Stable-enough-to-depend: -p/--print, --force, --trust, --sandbox disabled, --model, --workspace, --output-format text. Do not depend on --effort, --permission-mode, --input-format, or control_request.
claims.canonical_mechanism: parse quoted flags out of dispatch_cursor.py (signal 1) vs execute each against the binary (signal 2)
claims.strongest_caveat: --model cursor-grok-4.6-xhigh was not live-invoked as a full print session; only the --model flag's parser acceptance was measured (missing-arg).

claims.text: Negative control --res0015-invented-flag-xyzzy is rejected as unknown-option (python reason=unknown-option, exit=1). The acceptance test therefore discriminates: it is not silent in both states.
claims.canonical_mechanism: invented flag vs known --print: opposite verdicts
claims.strongest_caveat: Pairing an unknown flag with --help swallows the unknown-option error (commander prints help, exit 0). The control therefore must not use --help as the discriminator.
